title: The Same Number
short: See when two groups have the same number.

blocks.html: Sometimes two groups have the same number. Every cat gets one bowl, with no cats and no bowls left over. That’s the same!

blocks.name: pk-pic
blocks.cap: One bowl for each cat. Are they the same?

blocks.html: The same number means each one has a partner, with none left over.

For the grown-up: Setting the table is great practice: one plate for each person, one cup for each plate. Ask “Do we have enough?” and “Is it the same?” Keep screen time short: two or three problems, then play.

items: Try it at home: Set one spoon by each bowl.
Give each toy animal one block.
Count two piles and see if they match.

sources.name: Head Start Early Learning Outcomes Framework (ELOF), Mathematics Development, preschool goals P-MATH 1 to 10
